paper_metadata.title: Effects of Zr addition on the microstructures, mechanical properties and thermal stability of Cu-Ta alloys

evidence.quote: In this work, Cu-1.4 wt%Ta-Zr alloys with different Zr content (0, 0.1, 0.2 and 0.5 wt%) were fabricated by mechanical alloying combined with spark plasm sintering.
The obtained mechanical alloyed powders of Cu-1.4 wt%Ta, Cu-1.4 wt%Ta-0.1 wt%Zr, Cu-1.4 wt%Ta-0.2 wt%Zr and Cu-1.4 wt%Ta-0.5 wt%Zr were named as CT-0Zr, CT-0.1Zr, CT-0.2Zr and CT-0.5Zr, respectively.
Cu-1.4 wt%Ta alloy was prepared by mechanical alloying (MA) combined with spark plasm sintering (SPS)

The mechanical alloying process of the mixed powders was realized by high energy ball milling lasted for 40 h under 350 rpm with the ball-to-powder weight ratio of 10:1.
Then, all the powders were consolidated by spark plasm sintering at 850 ◦ C for 7 min under 50 MPa
followed with hot rolling at 850 ◦ C with a height reduction of 70%
